audience_question: Which retrofit barrier is most common overall, and did service turnaround improve?
form: evidence-led comparison slide with a conclusion banner, separate partner evidence panels, turnaround panel, and data-needed footer
fit_rationale: Separate panels preserve each partner's denominator and recording method, while the banner and turnaround panel make the two limits on inference explicit. A short footer specifies what comparable data would resolve each part of the question.
tradeoff: The slide gives less space to each partner's methodology so it can show both source-specific evidence and the turnaround caveat on one slide.
caveats: North's 40 respondents could select multiple barriers, so counts overlap.
South reviewed 15 open cases, not a reported count of homeowners served; other barriers were not recorded.
No shared period definition or compatible denominator supports an overall barrier ranking across partners.
South's 8-day median covers 11 cases; four case times are missing, and the prior 'around two weeks last spring' note has no identified cases, sample size, or method, so change cannot be inferred.
